objective:
Capacitorize services/agents-ui IN PLACE per specs/016-scaffold-ci-workspace/spec.md (do NOT create a second app package). Implement all of the following coherently in one change:

1) DEPENDENCIES (services/agents-ui/package.json): add Capacitor 7 deps pinned to ^7: '@capacitor/core', '@capacitor/cli' (devDep), '@capacitor/android', '@capacitor/ios', '@capacitor/app', '@capacitor/preferences'. Do NOT introduce duplicate Vue/TypeScript/Vite/Vitest majors. Add scripts: 'cap:sync': 'cap sync', 'cap:add:android': 'cap add android', 'cap:add:ios': 'cap add ios'. Keep existing scripts intact.

2) capacitor.config.ts at services/agents-ui/capacitor.config.ts: appId 'dev.extratoast.agents', appName 'ExtraToast Agents', webDir 'dist', a server block that reads an optional CAP_SERVER_URL env for live-reload during dev (cleartext only when set). Typed via CapacitorConfig import. Keep it valid for `cap` CLI.

3) PLATFORM ABSTRACTION (services/agents-ui/src/platform/): define stable TypeScript interfaces in 'types.ts' for the native capabilities feature code will need WITHOUT importing any Capacitor plugin directly: SecureStorage (getItem/setItem/removeItem -> Promise), AppUrlOpener (deep-link/open-url + an onAppUrlOpen listener registration), PlatformInfo (isNative: boolean, platform: 'web'|'android'|'ios'). Provide TWO implementations behind each interface: web fallbacks in 'web/' (SecureStorage backed by localStorage; AppUrlOpener using window.location/window.open + a no-op listener; PlatformInfo => {isNative:false, platform:'web'}) and capacitor-backed in 'capacitor/' (SecureStorage via @capacitor/preferences, AppUrlOpener via @capacitor/app appUrlOpen, PlatformInfo via Capacitor.getPlatform()). Add 'index.ts' exporting a resolvePlatform() that selects capacitor impls when Capacitor.isNativePlatform() is true, else web fallbacks; the capacitor modules must be dynamically imported so a pure web build never hard-requires native plugins at module load. Provide a Vue install/provide helper (e.g. createPlatform plugin) exposing the resolved services via provide/inject keys.

4) BOOTSTRAP SLOTS (services/agents-ui/src/main.ts): add scaffold-owned plugin-registration slots that resolve and register the platform plugin BEFORE router.mount, in a clearly-marked extension point comment block, without breaking existing bootstrap order (pinia, primevue, router, faro, etc.). Downstream features must be able to extend without reworking bootstrap order.

5) UNIT TESTS (vitest): test the WEB fallback adapters with NO native runtime — SecureStorage round-trips via a localStorage stub, PlatformInfo reports web, AppUrlOpener listener registration is a no-op-safe. Place under src/platform/__tests__/.

6) CI (.github/workflows/ci.yml): add four named jobs and include ALL of them in pipeline-complete.needs (alongside existing needs). Use 'pnpm install --no-frozen-lockfile' (repo has no lockfile). Reuse the existing pnpm/node setup pattern from the ui-check job (pnpm/action-setup + actions/setup-node with cache, working in services/agents-ui or via --filter). Jobs:
   - 'app-web-check' (App Web Check): pnpm install; run typecheck, lint, test, build for @extratoast/agents-ui.
   - 'app-contract' (App Contract): pnpm install; run the existing 'contract:check' script for @extratoast/agents-ui.
   - 'app-android-smoke' (App Android Smoke): set up JDK 21 (actions/setup-java temurin) and Android SDK (android-actions/setup-android@v3); pnpm install; build the web app; npx cap add android; npx cap sync android; then run ./gradlew assembleDebug in services/agents-ui/android. The android project is generated in CI (do not commit it).
   - 'app-native-e2e' (App Native E2E): a placeholder job that runs successfully (echo a TODO referencing spec 020) so the gate exists for later specs to fill; it must pass.
   Do NOT remove or rename existing jobs; only add these and extend pipeline-complete.needs.

7) .gitignore (services/agents-ui/.gitignore): ignore the generated native projects: '/android' and '/ios', plus '.capacitor/' and Capacitor build artifacts, so `cap add` output is not committed.

Constraints: keep the existing web product (terminal/streaming/PrimeVue/Tailwind) fully working; no new ESLint/typecheck errors; respect existing lint rules. Do not edit other services. Match existing code style.
validation: package.json has Capacitor 7 deps + cap scripts and no duplicated Vue/TS/Vite majors; capacitor.config.ts is valid; src/platform exposes interfaces with both web fallbacks and capacitor impls selected via resolvePlatform()/isNativePlatform with dynamic imports; main.ts registers the platform plugin before router.mount in a marked slot; vitest covers the web fallbacks and passes; ci.yml defines app-web-check, app-contract, app-android-smoke, app-native-e2e and pipeline-complete.needs includes all four; .gitignore excludes generated /android and /ios. Existing typecheck/lint/test/build for @extratoast/agents-ui still pass.
